```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
```



```{r loads_packs, include = F, echo = F}

library(scholar)
```

```{r makeHTMLversions}
# Knit the HTML version
rmarkdown::render("cv.Rmd",
                  params = list(pdf_mode = FALSE),
                  output_file = "cv.html")
```


```{r makeHTMLpriv}
rmarkdown::render("cv - priv.Rmd",
                  params = list(pdf_mode = TRUE),
                  output_file = "cv_priv.html")
```

```{r makeHTMLshort, eval = FALSE}
rmarkdown::render("cv_priv_short.Rmd",
                  params = list(pdf_mode = TRUE),
                  output_file = "cv_priv_short.html")
```


```{r makePDFcv}
# Convert to PDF using Pagedown
pdfCVname<-paste0("CV_Maximilian Larter  EN - ",Sys.Date(),".pdf")
pagedown::chrome_print("cv_priv.html", pdfCVname)
pdfCVname2<-paste0("short_CV_Maximilian Larter  EN - ",Sys.Date(),".pdf")
pagedown::chrome_print("cv_priv_short.html", pdfCVname2)
```
